{{Attr|Freeze}} }} ==Description== The '''Elite Ducky''' was an enemy that only appeared in [[Bathroom Approach]] which is part of the [[Ducky Revenge Event]] and its rerun in the [[Spring Frenzy Battle Pass]]. It is a stronger version of the [[Ducky (Ducky Revenge)|Ducky]], having significantly higher health, slightly faster speed, [[Stun Immunity]] and [[Freeze Immunity]]. It can be spawned by the [[Mega Ducky]] upon its death and [[Nerd Ducky]] with its ''Ducky Stampede'' ability. ==Logbook Description== "''Elite Ducky has achieved the highest merits one could receive in training and serves as a shining example for other ducklings. Military Ducky especially looks up to Elite Ducky for his resolve and determination in the army. Such loyalty is admirable, so much so that even Mega Ducky has taken notice.''' ==Appearance== The '''Elite Ducky''' is a yellow duck with black eyes, an orange beak and flippers. It is part of the Duck Army, meaning it wears appropriate army attire that consists of a blue suit with yellow buttons with a collared shirt underneath, and a black tie. On its shoulders, it has yellow shoulder pads. On its head it wears a blue garrison cap. It has three animations that it can randomly have, where all three also have differently shaped eyes. The first animation has it have a happy expression, the second has it have a serious expression while the third one has its eyes partially closed, likely because it is scared. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Bathroom Approach]] is listed instead. *As the '''Elite Ducky''' spawns in hordes, AOE towers like the [[Mortar]], [[Rocketeer]] or [[Golden Pyromancer]] can be used to deal with this enemy. **As the '''Elite Ducky''' has the [[Stun Immunity]], the [[Electroshocker]], alongside other stunning towers will only slow it down instead of stunning it. The same immunity also prevents it from being knocked back. *High DPS towers like the [[Pursuit]], [[Crook Boss]], [[Minigunner]], [[Ranger]] or [[Turret]] can be used to deal with this quite easily. *As the '''Elite Ducky''' has the [[Freeze Immunity]], it cannot be frozen or chilled by freezing towers. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1EliteDucky1.png|Green variant, current version, first animation variant (11 June 2025 – Present) DefHacker1EliteDucky2.png|Green variant, current version, second animation variant (11 June 2025 – Present) DefHacker1EliteDucky3.png|Green variant, current version, third animation variant (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseEliteDucky.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (16 April 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Ducky Battlepass -
